question.text: Open position limits for commodity index OPTIONS at the client level are:

answer.text: 10% of open interest or 2,000 lots, whichever is higher
5% of open interest or 1,000 lots, whichever is higher
15% of open interest or 10,000 lots, whichever is higher
3% of open interest or 500 lots, whichever is higher

explanation.text: The Logic: Per workbook p.45, client-level position limits for index options are 10% of open interest or 2,000 lots, whichever is higher, which is double the index futures client-level limit. The Trap: 5%/1,000 lots is the index futures client-level limit. 15%/10,000 is the futures member-level limit. 3%/500 is not a specified limit. Note: Pair the figure with the level (client vs member) and the product (futures vs options); index options client limits are explicitly double the index futures client limits.
